explanation: L0/N1363+ is a context-free token detector: its strength is a fixed function of the single token at the current position (per-token standard deviation 0.000 over the scan, token identity R^2 = 1.0, integrated gradients put 100% of the attribution on the peak token and 0% on any earlier token, and the value is unchanged when only the preceding text changes), and the token class it selects is technical/scientific notation rather than prose. Its strongest hits are the tokenizer's brace and formula pieces ('}{', '}}', '}^{', '_{', '}}{\'), identifier and constant pieces ('id', ' ID', 'guid', 'ById', 'namespace', 'NULL', 'MASK'), Latin/Greek lab and chemistry stems ('acceptor', ' GFP', ' affinity', 'fluores', 'hydrophobic', 'monoclonal', 'ligands'), and label-like tokens ('A', 'An', 'alpha', 'α', '1'), while ordinary lowercase prose words, punctuation-only tokens and whitespace stay at or below zero ('the', 'and', 'is' about -0.07), so predict the pole active on formula, identifier and technical-vocabulary tokens and inactive on ordinary prose; the leftover it does not cover is a scattered minority of longer ordinary words ('belong' 0.71, 'mystery' 0.70, 'birthday' 0.66) that also fire.
